g.text: A thread budget does not guarantee linear scaling
SIXEL, AVIF (aom/dav1d) and HEIC (x265/libde265): N workers.
WebP: parallel switch at N > 1. Pillow JPEG/GIF/PNG and QOI
remain serial. Bands show the per-photo interquartile range.
